title: Agent Pre-Completion Assurance and Verifiable Self-Audit Evidence

preflight.note: Prospective operator-requested design item after the separate 2026-11-22 instruction-only AGENTS.md draft rollout. No RepoPact enforcement implementation is claimed. WI078 already exists on a separate workspace-cleanup branch. On 2026-11-22, the operator subsequently authorized engineering execution in the WI079 conversation; implementation work is now active, without operator permission to modify protected surfaces or release.

acceptance_criteria.text: Reconcile existing work-item completion evidence, verification profiles, H14 admission closure, and WI044 claim semantics; document gaps and avoid a competing governance engine.

Compare instruction-only templates, typed review evidence, and optional completion-policy verification, including assurance claims, failure behavior, costs, compatibility, and operator authority; record the chosen design before implementation.

Define an exact review candidate identity covering review base, HEAD, staged/unstaged/untracked and renamed/deleted paths and worktrees. Detect stale evidence after changes, and honestly distinguish clean committed-tree from dirty-tree evidence.

Separate self-reported inspection, executed tools/tests, independent review, and operator approval. A self-audit PASS must never imply defect-free code, independent approval, authorization, admission closure, or release readiness.

Define concrete finding criteria, bounded surgical repairs, reverification, stop conditions, and truthful PASS/FAIL/INCOMPLETE outcomes; disallow speculative refactor churn, weakening tests, and unapproved scope expansion.

Implement the approved minimal, optional integration using canonical Rust semantics and existing evidence/verification primitives where possible; preserve legacy record validity and do not require a specific agent provider, cloud service, or always-on daemon.

Add positive/negative regression and conformance fixtures for clean passes, repaired defects, forged/missing/stale evidence, changed working trees, omitted untracked files, failed or unavailable checks, frozen/scope violations, and false independent-approval claims.

Prove the actual invocation, coverage, and effectiveness of any claimed completion check on supported integration boundaries, including attempted completion without current evidence. Treat instruction-only integrations and same-principal bypass risks accurately.

Preregister and compare ordinary verification, structured self-audit, and independent review on fixed tasks; measure escaped defects, false positives, churn, cost, and task success without assuming self-audit replaces independent reviewers.
Document adopter and nested-AGENTS.md guidance; link the 2026-11-22 draft rollout, reconcile documentation impacts and generated artifacts, and close only with criterion-linked concrete evidence.
